name: sons bedroom
description: A smaller room with a single bed pushed against the wall. A writing desk sits beneath the window, a half-melted candle on its surface.

items.name: Loose Floorboard
items.description: A floorboard that protrudes slightly from the rest, as if it can be pressed down or pried up.

items.name: Books of Mathematics and Magic
items.description: A stack of three leather-bound textbooks, their covers embossed with geometric patterns and astral symbols. The pages are filled with dense theorems and mystical incantations.

items.name: Hand-Painted Toy Soldier
items.description: A small wooden soldier with chipped paint, a faded red coat, and a tiny musket. His eyes are still bright.

exits.description: A modest door with a simple porcelain knob. Dust has gathered in the corners of the frame.
